snippet.title: Stash: A Card Looter - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Stash: A Card Looter is a roguelite autobattler with asynchronous multiplayer, where victory depends on drafting from a loot pile of randomized cards. 

Inspired by ARPG-style loot, all cards come in endless variations, from uniques and legendaries to powerful set items. 

Stash: A Card Looter launches on PC (Steam) worldwide on September 22, 2025.

#Gametrailers #Deckbuilder #CardGames
